name: Joseph Henry
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Decatur, Georgia
education: University of Miami School of Law
about: Attorney Joseph Henry is the managing partner of Hendrick & Henry Law in Decatur, Georgia. A top-ranked trial lawyer with more than nine years of total legal experience, Mr. Henry provides unmatched counsel and support to clients throughout the greater Atlanta metro region and surrounding areas who have legal needs involving any of the following:

Early in his legal career, Mr. Henry served as Criminal Investigator and Assistant Solicitor General with the Gwinnett County Government. As such, he has invisible insight into the criminal justice system, which helps him devise the most effective defense strategies possible for those accused of DUI/DWI, drug crimes, violent crimes, and other felonies and misdemeanors.

Equally effective in his personal injury practice, Mr. Henry has recovered substantial amounts of compensation for his plaintiff clients who suffered a serious injury or lost a loved one due to someone else's negligence. At all turns, he delivers highly aggressive advocacy both inside and outside of the courtroom to help his clients achieve their goals and obtain the justice they deserve as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible.

A 2007 graduate of Georgia Southern University's Parker School of Business with a Bachelor of Business Administration, Mr. Henry attended the University of Miami School of Law, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 2012. While there, he was a member of the school's negotiation competition team, and he received honors for his excellent academic achievements.
